scope: Source review and invented controls only; no actual coverage aggregation, likelihood, fitting or simulation.

must_fix_findings.issue: Generic pointer filter rejects supported actual regional aggregate and state-metadata operation forms before missing-output handling.
must_fix_findings.counterexample: state /nuisance/N or select /absolute_rows rejected as reference pointer.
must_fix_findings.required: Operation-specific guards preserving approved current aggregate/state semantics and rejecting expected/reference operands.

must_fix_findings.issue: A top-level passed case completion with a failed individual case is accepted.
must_fix_findings.counterexample: Invented exact60-case completion with cases[0].passed=false still reconciles all case fields.
must_fix_findings.required: Require every terminal case success and unique exact protocol/completion rosters before admitting their aggregate cells.

must_fix_findings.issue: Required fields are only supplied mappings, so a partial nonempty numeric table mapping can produce top-level passed with no gap.
must_fix_findings.counterexample: Invented table has score columns -1.0 and999.0; mapping only the first still yields mapped_fields_reconciled and passed=true.
must_fix_findings.required: Use an inventory-backed field census or explicit non-score/exclusion dispositions. Unmapped score fields must remain unresolved and prevent terminal completeness.

prior_scope_review: Prior reports are preserved under separate prior_replay_retained labels with exact declared resource hashes; no new likelihood implied.
case_crosswalk_review: The method/persistence/source positions for initial-mark and S02 match frozen table contracts, including S02 interval tokens and non-null paired rows; individual-case success and coverage completeness still require fixes above.
